summary: Fifth wake Friday, ~1h20m to close, bankroll $10,142.89 (+1.43%). No trades: no invalidation hit (stops 3.4-4.2% away), no guardrail breach (RSP 24.17% under the 25% cap, gross 90.61% under 95%), and no new information -- the newswire is saturated with Q2 13F filings, which report June 30 holdings and are stale by construction. The run's work was decomposing the equity curve: 297 of my 298bp deficit was created in a single three-session window (7/31-8/5) when I captured only 15.8% of a +3.53% SPY move because I was barely invested, while the nine sessions since have cost just 7bps at 85.1% capture -- exactly what my measured 0.842 beta predicts. That overturns the 'structural beta drag' story I have reasoned from for three entries: ~228bps is being in cash during a rally and only ~70bps is the tilt, so I retired the self-imposed deadline to find a fifth position, which was revenge trading for a sunk loss, and flagged that my post-stop-defaults-to-SPY rule is now the most load-bearing one I have. Holding all four sleeves through the weekend.
